prompts.identity: Use case: logo-brand. Create a production-quality square app icon for an identity-verification utility. A distinctive abstract person symbol integrated with a precise check mark as one coherent bold emblem. Professional flat graphic design, crisp geometric curves, excellent legibility at 48 pixels. Use a restrained dark neutral background and one clean bright accent. The background fills the entire square edge to edge. The emblem fills roughly 78 percent of the square with balanced small margins. No outside white canvas, no inset app tile, no outer rounded-corner cutout, no shield, no padlock, no passport, no photographic face, no plastic 3D, no fake lighting, no gradient gloss, no letters, no words, no watermark. Deliver only the icon artwork, not a mockup or presentation.
prompts.webextrator: Use case: logo-brand. Create a production-quality square app icon for a web extraction utility. The background fills the entire square edge to edge, with a clear contrasting large central emblem occupying about 78 percent of the canvas. No outside white canvas, no inset tile, no outer rounded-corner cutout, no tiny interface details, no magnifying glass, no globe, no plastic 3D, no fake lighting, no gradient gloss, no letters, no words, no watermark. Deliver only the icon artwork.
prompts.localization: Use case: logo-brand. Create a production-quality square app icon for a translation and localization utility. Two bold overlapping language panels in one balanced geometric emblem. The first panel contains the single Latin capital A; the second contains the single Chinese character 文. Exact text: A and 文, no other letters or words. Modern flat graphic design, confident substantial shapes, clear contrast, visually coherent with a professional software tool. The icon must remain legible at 48 pixels. Use a restrained background and a complementary accent. Background fills the square edge to edge; emblem occupies about 80 percent, leaving only small balanced margins. No outside white canvas, no inset app tile, no outer rounded-corner cutout, no plastic 3D, no gradients, no fake lighting, no watermark. Deliver only the icon artwork.
